title: agropyron bicorne
intro: Agropyron bicorne, commonly known as two-horned wheat grass, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron bicorne include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve immune function, and act as an anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
